name: Ariana Gandhi
source:
Ariana Gandhi is now the fully brainwashed sex slave of Dario Dalisso.

Note that she does not show up in the game. Her character sprite only appears in the end credits of the game.

The game confirms that Ariana Gandhi has obtained her Guards Instructor License and has shown exemplary results in sharpshooting, leadership and combined arms operations. 

This license being obtained was likely implemented on Dario order's so that Ariana could be more useful to him in the future. 

Also note that Ariana is tanned chocolate brown as part of her sexual corruption process noted in the Isis game. Dario tanned her this way during her sexual corruption.
